Every Mobile Legends collaboration: skins, heroes and dates

14 collaborations and 61 skins: which heroes became Naruto, Gojo or SpongeBob, which skins were free and what is known about Avatar.

In this story

  1. All collaborations
  2. The first collaborations: 2019–2021
  3. 2022: Sanrio, Kung Fu Panda, Neymar Jr and Saint Seiya
  4. 2023–2024: Jujutsu Kaisen, Ducati and Attack on Titan
  5. 2025–2026: Hunter x Hunter, Naruto, SpongeBob and Street Fighter 6
  6. Avatar: The Last Airbender in December 2026
  7. How collaboration skins are obtained
All news

All collaborationsThe first collaborations: 2019–20212022: Sanrio, Kung Fu Panda, Neymar Jr and Saint Seiya2023–2024: Jujutsu Kaisen, Ducati and Attack on Titan2025–2026: Hunter x Hunter, Naruto, SpongeBob and Street Fighter 6Avatar: The Last Airbender in December 2026How collaboration skins are obtained

In brief

  • Since 2019 MLBB has had 14 collaborations and 61 skins from other universes, from The King of Fighters to Street Fighter 6.
  • In 2025 a free collaboration skin came with the year-end Friend Fest event: Cyclops "SpongeBob".
  • According to Pinoy Gamer, Friend Fest 2026 starts on 4 December together with Avatar: The Last Airbender, and Zilong "Aang" will be free. MOONTON has not published a press release yet.
  • Chou has the most collaboration skins: four. Dyrroth, Julian and Valir have three each.

A collaboration skin turns an MLBB hero into a character from an anime, a film, another game or a brand. These skins are sold only during the event and never reach the regular shop. The only way back is a rerun, and players sometimes wait years for one.

The first collaborations: 2019–2021

The first was The King of Fighters: in 2019 Guinevere, Chou and Karina became Athena, Iori and Leona. Star Wars and Transformers followed two years later, and since then there has been a collaboration every year. KOF came back twice, with the last wave in 2024.

2022: Sanrio, Kung Fu Panda, Neymar Jr and Saint Seiya

The busiest year: four collaborations, including the first one with an athlete. In Saint Seiya each of the three heroes got two skins, in bronze and gold armour.

2023–2024: Jujutsu Kaisen, Ducati and Attack on Titan

This is when MLBB moved to major anime: Satoru Gojo went to Xavier, Levi to Martis and Mikasa to Fanny. Ducati is still the only collaboration with a motorcycle brand: its skins are riders on the Monster, Panigale and Diavel models.

2025–2026: Hunter x Hunter, Naruto, SpongeBob and Street Fighter 6

Naruto came in two parts: five skins in 2025, then Minato on Gusion and Itachi on Julian in spring 2026, together with a rerun of the first five. The second part ended on 11 May 2026. SpongeBob arrived for the Friend Fest event at the end of 2025, and the Cyclops skin was free. Street Fighter 6 was the first collaboration with Capcom: in July 2026 Paquito, Chou, Guinevere and Dyrroth became Ryu, Ken, Chun-Li and Guile.

Avatar: The Last Airbender in December 2026

The Philippine outlet Pinoy Gamer reports an Avatar follow event in the game from 20 November to 3 December 2026: logging in earns Friend Coins. Friend Fest starts on 4 December, and the coins buy the new Zilong "Aang" skin. The same report mentions a free battle emote and an avatar border.

The rest is leaks so far. In September the leaker RedMoon named the collaboration heroes: Kadita, Masha, Valir and Zilong. MOONTON has not announced who becomes Katara, Toph or Zuko. A year ago the similar SpongeBob event ran everywhere except the United States, France, Italy, the United Kingdom, Spain and five more countries, so Russia was included. Whether Avatar works the same way will be clear on 4 December.

How collaboration skins are obtained

  • The main skins come from event draws paid with Diamonds or tokens. A skin is usually guaranteed after a set number of draws, and the final cost depends on luck.
  • One or two skins are often free for tasks and logins, like Cyclops "SpongeBob" and, reportedly, Zilong "Aang".
  • After the event the skins are not sold. The next chance is a rerun: KOF came back after four years, Naruto after one.

FAQ

How many collaborations has Mobile Legends had?

14 from 2019 to 2026, 61 skins in total. Avatar: The Last Airbender would be the fifteenth if it launches in December.

What is the next MLBB collaboration?

According to Pinoy Gamer, Avatar: The Last Airbender with Friend Fest from 4 December 2026. MOONTON has not published an official press release yet.

Can I get a collaboration skin for free?

Sometimes. Cyclops "SpongeBob" was given for Friend Coins in Friend Fest 2025, and Zilong "Aang" is reported to work the same way. The main skins of an event are usually paid.

Will the Naruto skins come back?

The second part of Naruto ended on 11 May 2026. MOONTON called it the final arc of the collaboration and has not announced another rerun.
